name: Chest Supported Row Machine
instructions: Set the chest pad so that when you lean into it your arms reach the handles with a slight bend and your shoulders are free to move.
Sit or stand into the machine, chest against the pad, and take the handles with a neutral or overhand grip. This is your starting position.
Pull the handles towards you, leading with the elbows and drawing the shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
Pause briefly with the shoulder blades squeezed, then let the handles travel back out until the arms are straight and the shoulder blades have spread apart again.
Because the pad supports your torso, the lower back does no work holding position — this is the row to use when a bent-over row is the thing that fatigues first.
